content: संगवः <ab>N.</ab> of a particular part of the day, said to be three Muhūrtas after Prātastana or early dawn and to form the second of the five divisions of the day; अथ यत् संगववेलायां स आदिः <ls>Ch. Up. 2. 9. 4</ls>; मां केशवो गदया प्रातरव्याद्गोविन्द आसंगवमात्तवेणुः <ls>Bhāg. 6. 8. 20</ls>.
